addr: #13&14, Adarsh Nagar, KHB Colony Main Rd, Near RK Palace Auditorium, Kanaka Nagar, Kaval Bairasandra, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560032, India

rev.t:
Damaged product offered. Just open in front of shopkeeper and he just refused to consider the return. Staff training is must and nothing goes to respond politely. Surely not the outlet I’ll repeat.
Owners please see if you can.

The super market has huge variety of groceries from kitchen needs to general purpose items. All the stuffs are kept in a neat and clean matter so it is easy for people to find the item they are searching for. Now the store has an app which will help the instant delivery of items to home. There is a vegetable shop attached to it too.
We buy all our home needs from this place since it started operation in the past, good product display and service,
